features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/feat-054-local-deployment-smoke.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/feat-054-local-deployment-smoke.e2e.spec.ts --grep 'clean local deployment records startup duration and completes one routed request' && bash -lc 'GATEWAY_PORT=4101 CONSOLE_PORT=3101 WORKER_HEARTBEAT_MS=100000 ./init.sh & pid=$!; start=$(date +%s); sleep 5; curl -fsS http://localhost:4101/health; curl -fsS -I http://localhost:3101; end=$(date +%s); echo startup_smoke_seconds=$((end-start)); kill $pid; wait $pid || true'
features.evidence: No verification evidence yet; feature is not_started.
